scope: All3seeds and completed L0 history prefixes0..20; prefixes0..19 correspond to hypothetical next requests1..20. Prefix20 is included only as a conservative after-final-round audit.
actual_L0_notes: All60 notes are the actual empty L0 notes; no L1 notes invented.
future_L1_note_bytes: Unknown; no synthetic300-character allowance mixed into empirical measurements.
source_deduplication: Original source SHA256 definition once; no source or note truncation.
trim_policy: Archive every complete original definition, LOFO contribution, aggregated TRAIN/validation failure, ordered query payload/statistics and <=300-Unicode-character note. Prompt JSON stores each original source once under its SHA256 and references it from records. Measure the entire canonical JSON using the frozen local counter, excluding only the outer prompt label. If it exceeds6000 tokens retain the 30 unique source definitions ranked by latest delta_without_minus_full descending (None last; ties first_seen_round,first_seen_feature_index,source_sha256), plus all four record types from the latest3 rounds and every historical note/query statistic. Never truncate source or notes. If that single deterministic view still exceeds6000 tokens, stop the entire stage before a model call.
actual_runtime_if_required_trimmed_memor: MemoryBudgetExceeded; stop whole stage before request; no fallback truncation or rule changes.
